creator: millee.md
title: 'Securitymaxxing pt.2': 10-point security checklist for vibe-coded apps (IDOR/access control, API key origin restriction, package updates, upload type/size checks, parameterized queries, tokens in secure cookies not localStorage, Stripe webhook verification, security headers, no over-fetching other users' data, 2FA on hosting/DB/domain)

tools.name: Stigg
tools.detail: diagram shows Stigg <-> Stripe (incidental stock image)

claims: Proper access control so changing an ID in the URL cannot expose others' records
API key must not accept requests from websites other than your own
File uploads checked for type and size
Login tokens in secure cookies, not localStorage
API responses do not leak other users' data
2FA on hosting, database and domain accounts
Next video promises prompts to fix each
how_to_steps: Walk your app through the 10 checks above and count how many pass
on_screen_only: Stock diagrams: 'ACCESS CONTROLS' (physical vs logical), 'Copy your API key' dialog, package tooling diagram, file upload UI, C# SqlCommand parameterized query code ('SELECT TOP 1000 * FROM Users WHERE DisplayName = @DisplayName'), OAuth client/auth-server/resource-server diagram, Stigg/Stripe diagram, perpetrator-server-victim XSS diagram, 2FA login flow
cta: Comment how many your app checked off; follow for fix prompts

relevance.why: Concrete checklist that applies to every app Haji ships (Supabase/Stripe stacks). Veteran-facing apps hold PII, so IDOR, over-fetching and 2FA on infra accounts matter.

implement_score.why: Turn the 10 items into a /security-review checklist prompt or CLAUDE.md pre-ship gate and run it on each app; most fixes are small (cookie flags, webhook verification, headers, RLS). Hours, not days.

verify: 'API key doesn't accept requests from other websites' conflates CORS/referrer restrictions with real auth; public keys still need server-side checks

gap.what: Overlaps the liked 'six login-security gaps' and 'top 5 security holes' videos but adds items not covered there: upload validation, Stripe webhook signature verification, secure-cookie vs localStorage tokens, security headers, response over-fetching, and 2FA on hosting/DB/domain.
